set.acceptance: Go guide tests: rhiza guide ls lists plan as a skill and the four plan role topics; rhiza guide plan names the four topics with their skill and rhiza guide routes; rhiza guide planner names plan-recipes and plan-interview; rhiza guide plan-recipes holds an apply recipe for a leaf with statement and acceptance fields and a decided-by link, and says that no plan file and no checkboxes are kept; each text stays within its cap and plan's description within MaxDescription.
set.statement: rhiza guide plan, a skill installed as rhiza-plan, is the plan index: it names the planner, plan-reviewer, plan-critic and plan-reviser topics and says which a planner, reviewer, critic and reviser load; the planner topic carries what a planning session plans, in what order, and that every leaf, acceptance check, Decision and question goes into the model through rhiza apply, and its Read first names plan-recipes and plan-interview; rhiza guide plan-recipes holds the apply recipes and says no plan file and no checkboxes are kept.
